title: Cursor media frame
description: An empty stand-in for a picture, product window or photo: a soft vertical wash from the theme's glow colour into its muted surface (picture), or a flat muted panel (plain), cropped to the slot's size and radius. Shows its child instead when one is given.
notes: size, aspect ratio and radius come from className; children are cropped like object-fit: cover
name: cursor-media

props.name: children
props.description: a real image or video; it fills the frame (object-fit: cover)

props.name: tone
props.description: picture: a soft glow-to-muted wash (painted backdrops) · plain: a flat glow-tinted panel (photos, avatars)

props.name: label
props.description: a name for screen readers when the slot is empty
